dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle outward convexity on the right lateral margin; the left margin remains relatively linear with minimal deviation.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light lavender-grey median pixel intensity; categorized as a transition between immature grey and mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, darker grey patches distributed primarily across the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the light-grey baseline and localized mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, low-contrast linear mark visible on the right posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a faint, longitudinal linear mark on the right side of the dorsal surface, consistent with a healed scratch.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, shadow-casting dorsal ridge extending along the central longitudinal axis and a distinct dark aperture at the anterior end.
